question.text: The rules on appointment of external service providers (custodian, auditor) to a PMS are:

answer.text: Must be empanelled and comply with SEBI's requirements

explanation.text: The Logic: Custodians must be SEBI-registered; auditors must satisfy continuing-professional standards; contract terms prescribed. The Trap: Free-choice appointment is not permitted. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-B specific. Manager's Pro-Tip: Rotate auditors per the ICAI/SEBI cycle — continuous tenure violations trigger regulatory issues.
